knowledgeAnswers.rationale: For a single case the frequency stays the same as the standard clean and the method is raised to detergent plus disinfectant on most elements of the isolated room.
The discharge clean is performed after the patient leaves through discharge, transfer or death, and before the following patient moves into the space.
An outbreak is more cases than expected or two or more connected cases. Both frequency and method rise across the entire functional area until the coordinators lower the outbreak status.

practicalCriteria: Assessor presents three triggers and the learner names the correct clean for each, with all three correct
Learner signs a sample schedule line for a discharge clean, with the sign-off in the right column
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of the trigger exercise
stopWorkCriteria: A spill is reported and the learner has no spill kit or PPE for it
A patient's precaution status is unclear and cannot be confirmed
